class.name: NNActionGroup
class.brief_description: Groups child actions to run them in sequence, randomly, conditionally, or via a custom rule.
class.description: Add as a child of an [NNBehaviour] or another [NNActionGroup] to combine multiple [NNAction] nodes into structured workflows. Use [member action_execution_rule] to run children in sequence, pick one at random, branch on a boolean ([member if_else_boolean_value]), or choose the next child in script via [method on_select_child]. Action groups can be nested arbitrarily deep.

method.name: on_select_child
method.description: Called under [code]CustomRule[/code] to pick the next child to run. Return the index of an enabled [NNAction] or [NNActionGroup] child, or [code]-1[/code] to finish the group.

members.member: How child actions are selected: [code]Sequence[/code] ([code]0[/code]) runs enabled children in order, [code]PickOneAtRandom[/code] ([code]1[/code]) picks one enabled child at random, [code]IfElse[/code] ([code]2[/code]) runs child [code]0[/code] or [code]1[/code] based on [member if_else_boolean_value], and [code]CustomRule[/code] ([code]3[/code]) calls [method on_select_child].
Child index of the currently active [NNAction] or nested [NNActionGroup], or [code]-1[/code] when finished.

What happens when a child finishes with [member NNActions.has_failed] set: [code]EndExecution[/code] ([code]0[/code]) stops and fails the group; [code]ContinueExecution[/code] ([code]1[/code]) ignores the failure and moves on.
Branch selector for [code]IfElse[/code]: [code]true[/code] runs child [code]0[/code], [code]false[/code] runs child [code]1[/code].

signal.name: action_failed
signal.description: Emitted when a direct child [NNAction] finishes with [member NNActions.has_failed] set.
